title: Study Room Check-In
locationRef: University study room, 9pm the week before submission. Fluorescent lights, one laptop screen glowing.
setup: Riley is staring at her screen, barely acknowledging you. Her section of the group project is untouched.
storyPlot: You and Riley have been assigned the same group project for the past three weeks. You don't know each other well — just well enough to split the work and agree on a submission date. That date is less than a week away, and your parts are more or less done. But Riley's section is blank in the shared doc, and she's been going quiet in the group chat. You booked the study room tonight hoping to work, but really, you came because something felt off. Riley is already here when you arrive, laptop open, eyes on the screen, looking like someone holding something together through sheer will alone.
openingLine: Riley doesn't look up. 'Hey.' A pause. 'You don't need to stay if you've got other stuff.'
successCondition: Composite score ≥ 65 and Riley reveals they haven't started OR accepts help
failureCondition: Composite score < 35 OR Riley asks you to leave
